key_provisions_or_claims: RAM assesses Viet Nam's AI ecosystem across five dimensions: legal, social, education, economy, technical infrastructure
Recommends integrating AI ethics into national legislation and adopting technical and ethical standards
Recommends regulatory sandboxes and a National AI Ethics Committee
Highlights gaps in STEM access for women, ethnic minorities, persons with disabilities
Calls for AI ethics in training, workforce upskilling, and environmental/cultural considerations
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news article on the launch of Viet Nam's AI Readiness Assessment (RAM) report under the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. It summarises strengths and gaps and recommends integrating AI ethics into legislation, standards, regulatory sandboxes, a National AI Ethics Committee, and capacity building.
annotation.title_clean: Viet Nam launches first comprehensive national report on AI ethics under UNESCO framework
annotation.title_en: Viet Nam launches first comprehensive national report on AI ethics under UNESCO framework
